source: Yahoo Finance delayed daily chart (query2). Not a live pit.
thesis: A carton is farm + 原物料 + miles + FX + the buyer. Almost no fresh item has a futures pit. Listed names are the cost stack around the carton — fertilizer, diesel, greenhouse gas, truck, boat, box, peso / CAD, and the grocers who set programs. They are not AMS FOB and they are not your invoice.
disclaimer: Yahoo delayed quotes (~15 minutes), not advice, not a cleared produce trade. HO=F is heating oil / ULSD, the diesel proxy — not a farm print. OJ=F is frozen concentrated orange juice. Iceberg and berries still do not have a ticker.

lenses.blurb: The few produce names that actually report as public companies.

relations.then: Next planting's cost floor moves. Farm-gate and then FOB lag — this week's lettuce does not reprice overnight.
Landed GTA / DC can rise with origin FOB flat. Salinas and Yakima feel it first.
Chile grapes, Peru asparagus / avocado / blueberry, NZ kiwi get more expensive to land. Counter-season is a boat.
Programs get leaned on even in a short crop. Retail is bargaining power, not a farm print.
Restaurant pull for kits, tomatoes, fries. A bag of salad is not NASS head lettuce.
Mexico winter veg and Hass can print cheaper in USD at Nogales / McAllen. Ontario greenhouse sells spec against that floor.
The same USDA / AMS dollar FOB costs more in CAD. Compass farm prints move without the field moving.
Florida freeze or Brazil pulp. Fresh navels on a retail rack are a different desk. Pair with Alico, not a carton of Valencias.
Reefer miles get more expensive. Landed Vancouver / GTA can rise with origin FOB flat. Salinas, Yakima, Nogales feel it first.
Ontario / BC greenhouse heat jumps. Village Farms winter tomatoes, cukes, peppers. Field tomatoes do not.
Next leafy and sweet-corn cost floor. This week's lettuce FOB does not reprice overnight.
Chile grapes, kiwi, berries can print cheaper in USD. Still a boat (ZIM).
Rooms are tight or rates are up — apples, pears, onions, kiwi, fries. Storage crops, not berries.

Apples.read: No apple futures. Storage rooms (COLD), tray cartons (IP), and grocery programs (KR / COST) are the listed weather around Washington / Ontario fruit.

Strawberries.read: Driscoll's is private. Clamshell film (AMCR), truck (KNX), Costco / Kroger programs, and the peso for Mexico winter are the listed names. NASS cwt is too coarse for a clamshell.

Grapes (Table).read: Chile counter-season rides a boat (ZIM). Dole and Del Monte still pack table grapes. No grape futures.

Peaches.read: A short US peach window, then Chile. Truck in season, boat counter-season. No listed peach ranch.

Pears.read: Storage crop on the same desk as apples. COLD rooms and carton paper matter more than any ticker with 'pear' in the name — there isn't one.

Tomatoes.read: Village Farms is the listed greenhouse. Mexico winter (peso + Nogales truck) sets the floor. Sysco buys spec, not NASS rounds.

Lettuce.read: Taylor Farms and Fresh Express are private. The listed tape is the kit buyers (SYY / USFD), Salinas truck, salad film, and next crop's fertilizer.

Potatoes.read: Lamb Weston is fries, not a fresh carton. Storage (COLD) and foodservice (SYY) still move the russet story.

Onions.read: Storage crop. Rooms and trucks, not a pit. Grocery ads (WMT) can dump a district.

Broccoli.read: Salinas / desert brassica. Truck and nitrogen. No listed broccoli grower.

Carrots.read: Grimmway and Bolthouse are private and most of US fresh carrots. Listed weather is storage, grocery, and fertilizer.

Cauliflower.read: Same desert-and-Salinas clock as lettuce. No listed name. Watch truck and foodservice.

Celery.read: Oxnard / Salinas / Yuma rotation. Truck and nitrogen. No listed celery ranch.

Cucumbers.read: Greenhouse (VFF) vs Mexico winter (peso). Ontario sells spec against that floor.

Beans.read: US snap window then Florida / Mexico winter. Truck and the peso. No listed snap-bean name.

Asparagus.read: Peru boat (ZIM) and Mexico spears (peso) are the counter-season. US CA / WA is a short spring.

Sweet Corn.read: The window walks north. Not #2 yellow corn futures. Truck, grocery ads, iron and fertilizer.

Melons.read: California / Arizona then Mexico. Truck and peso. Del Monte still touches melon programs.

Avocados.read: Mission (AVO) is the listed avocado desk after buying Calavo in 2026. Peso for Mexico, boat for Peru, Costco for volume.

Bananas.read: Closest thing produce has to a world price — still not a futures pit. Dole and Del Monte are the listed boats. Pink-sheet bananas live on World.

Lemons.read: Limoneira is the listed lemon ranch. Dole packs citrus. No lemon futures.

Limes.read: Mexico is the lime belt. The peso is the listed name. Limoneira is lemon-first.

Oranges.read: OJ=F is frozen concentrate, not a navel carton. Alico is Florida groves. Fresh navels still trade as a district FOB.

Pineapples.read: Tropical program fruit. Dole and Del Monte own the listed story. Boat, not a pit.

Peppers.read: Greenhouse vs Mexico, same as tomatoes and cukes. Village Farms is the listed GH name.

Blueberries.read: Peru / Chile boats and clamshells. Driscoll's is private. Costco can make a week.

Raspberries.read: Clamshell and truck. No listed raspberry grower. Mexico / CA / WA windows.

Mangoes.read: Tropical import. Del Monte and the boat. No mango futures.

Kiwi Fruit.read: NZ / Italy / Chile. Boat plus storage. Zespri is a co-op, not a ticker.

Mushrooms.read: Indoor crop, private houses. Foodservice and grocery ads are the listed weather.

Garlic.read: China / Mexico / CA. Boat and peso. Retail ads move the jar more than the bulb pit — there is no pit.

defaultCrop.read: No listed grower for this carton. Watch truck (KNX), fertilizer (NTR), carton paper (IP), and the buyers (KR, SYY) — they move landed cost even when farm-gate is quiet.

universe.name: Dole plc
universe.what: Bananas, pineapple, packed fruit. Sold the US fresh-veg book.
universe.means: A DOLE move is banana / pineapple program weather — not Salinas lettuce.

universe.name: Del Monte Corporation
universe.what: Bananas, pineapple, fresh-cut. Was Fresh Del Monte (FDP); ticker became DMC in June 2026 after taking Del Monte Foods assets.
universe.means: Watch DMC when banana boats or fresh-cut programs are the question — not Salinas lettuce.

universe.name: Mission Produce
universe.what: Avocados. Bought Calavo in May 2026. Origin-switch (Mexico / Peru / California) plus ripening rooms and guacamole.
universe.means: AVO is now the listed avocado desk. Green FOB is not the ripe invoice. Calavo (CVGW) no longer prints.

universe.name: Limoneira
universe.what: California lemon ranch, plus avocados and oranges. Water and greening risk.
universe.means: LMNR is one of the few listed citrus ranches. Not a carton futures print.

universe.name: Alico
universe.what: Florida orange groves. Freeze, greening, juice vs fresh.
universe.means: ALCO is grove land and juice oranges — pair it with OJ futures, not navels at retail.

universe.name: Village Farms
universe.what: Greenhouse tomatoes, cucumbers, peppers (and a cannabis book).
universe.means: VFF is the listed greenhouse name vs the Mexico winter floor. Cannabis noise is not a cuke.

universe.name: Lamb Weston
universe.what: Frozen fries. Russet farm is an input; the SKU is a restaurant fry.
universe.means: LW is process potato, not a fresh carton of russets on a wholesale dock.

universe.name: Nutrien
universe.what: Potash, nitrogen, retail farm centres. Biggest listed fertilizer name.
universe.means: If NTR rips, next season's cost floor moves. Farm-gate lags weeks to months.

universe.name: Mosaic
universe.what: Phosphate and potash.
universe.means: Same weather as NTR, phosphate-heavy. Not a carton print.

universe.name: CF Industries
universe.what: Nitrogen (urea, ammonia).
universe.means: Nitrogen spikes show up in leafy and corn cost, not this week's FOB.

universe.name: Deere
universe.what: Iron. Grower capex cycle.
universe.means: DE is whether farms buy machines, not what a clamshell costs tomorrow.

universe.name: Corteva
universe.what: Seeds and crop protection.
universe.means: CTVA is next planting's chemistry and genetics, lagged into farm-gate.

universe.name: Americold
universe.what: Temperature-controlled warehouses. A REIT on cold rooms.
universe.means: COLD occupancy / rates are storage-crop weather: apples, pears, onions, kiwi, fries.

universe.name: Knight-Swift
universe.what: The biggest listed trucker. Produce rides the same lanes as dry van — reefer is tighter.
universe.means: If KNX rips on tightness, landed GTA can rise with origin FOB flat.

universe.name: ZIM Integrated
universe.what: Ocean container line. Counter-season Chile / Peru / NZ boats.
universe.means: A ZIM spike is boat weather for grapes, blueberries, asparagus, avocados, kiwi.

universe.name: Amcor
universe.what: Flexible packaging and clamshells.
universe.means: Berry and salad-kit film cost. A bag can be the SKU more than the leaf.

universe.name: International Paper
universe.what: Corrugated cartons and trays.
universe.means: Apple, citrus, and banana boxes. Carton cost is a line on every FOB.

universe.name: Kroger
universe.what: Largest US grocer. Sets produce programs and slotting.
universe.means: If KR is squeezing, FOB programs get leaned on even in a short crop.

universe.name: Costco
universe.what: Warehouse club. Huge on berries, avocados, citrus, organic.
universe.means: COST volume can clear a district — or reject a spec and leave it on the dock.

universe.name: Walmart
universe.what: The price-setter for a lot of North American produce retail.
universe.means: WMT retail is not wholesale. A WMT move is bargaining power, not a farm print.

universe.name: Sysco
universe.what: Broadline foodservice. Buys kits, tomatoes, leafy, potatoes.
universe.means: SYY is whether restaurants are pulling. Lettuce kits live here, not on NASS cwt.

universe.name: US Foods
universe.what: Second broadline. Same desk as Sysco, different houses.
universe.means: Foodservice pull for fresh-cut and foodservice tomato / leafy.

universe.name: Performance Food
universe.what: Third broadline plus convenience.
universe.means: Same foodservice weather as SYY, smaller book.

universe.name: FCOJ futures
universe.what: ICE frozen concentrated orange juice. The only fruit with a real pit.
universe.means: This is juice, not a fresh navel carton. Florida freeze / Brazil pulp hits this.

universe.name: Invesco DB Agriculture
universe.what: Grains, sugar, cattle, cocoa. Almost no fresh produce weight.
universe.means: DBA ripping is feed and freight weather around produce — not iceberg.

universe.name: VanEck Agribusiness
universe.what: Deere, fertilizer, processors. Listed ag businesses, not cartons.
universe.means: MOO is the input-and-iron complex. Pair with NTR / DE, not AMS FOB.

universe.name: US dollar / Canadian dollar
universe.what: Converts USDA USD prints into CAD landed.
universe.means: A stronger USD makes US FOB more expensive in CAD even if the carton did not move.

universe.name: US dollar / Mexican peso
universe.what: Mexico winter veg and avocado cost in dollars.
universe.means: A weak peso can print cheaper Nogales FOB in USD. Sinaloa tomatoes, berries, Hass.

universe.name: NY Harbor ULSD / heating oil
universe.what: The listed diesel proxy. Reefers and long-haul burn this, not crude.
universe.means: If HO=F rips, landed GTA can rise with origin FOB sitting still. Every Salinas / Yakima / Nogales mile.

universe.name: Henry Hub natural gas
universe.what: Greenhouse heat. Ontario and BC glass burn gas in winter.
universe.means: NG=F is Village Farms' winter cost floor — tomatoes, cukes, peppers — not a field tomato.

universe.name: WTI crude
universe.what: Parent of diesel and of plastic resin for clamshells and bags.
universe.means: Crude is two steps from the carton: freight (HO=F) and film (AMCR). Don't quote it as FOB.

universe.name: CVR Partners
universe.what: Listed urea ammonium nitrate. The nitrogen print closest to a farm invoice.
universe.means: UAN ripping is next leafy / corn cost, not this week's FOB. Pair with CF.

universe.name: ICL Group
universe.what: Potash, phosphate, specialty plant nutrition.
universe.means: Same fertilizer weather as NTR / MOS, specialty-heavy. Lagged into farm-gate.

universe.name: Packaging Corp
universe.what: Corrugated boxes and trays — the carton around the carton.
universe.means: A PKG move is box cost on apples, citrus, bananas. A line on every FOB.

universe.name: Union Pacific
universe.what: West-coast rail. Potatoes, onions, apples, citrus ride this when truck is tight.
universe.means: UNP is the long-haul alternative to KNX. Storage crops, not berries.

universe.name: US dollar / Chilean peso
universe.what: Chile counter-season grapes, kiwi, berries, stone fruit.
universe.means: A weak peso can print cheaper Chilean FOB in USD. Pair with ZIM — it's still a boat.

universe.name: New Zealand dollar / US dollar
universe.what: NZ kiwi and apples into North America.
universe.means: Zespri is a co-op. The kiwi is a boat plus this FX print.

universe.name: US dollar / Peruvian sol
universe.what: Peru asparagus, avocado, blueberry boats.
universe.means: Counter-season Peru is sol plus ZIM. Not a California print.
